components.name: ⚙️ Builds (CI)
components.description: Any outages related to running builds on Bitrise. Some examples: build queues, builds fail to start, issues with scheduled builds, Steps, the Workflow Editor, and failures on app.bitrise.io.

components.name: 📦 Release Management
components.description: Any outages related to app distribution, device testing, install pages, and other features and services for Release Management.

components.name: 📲 CodePush
components.description: Any outages related to OTA update delivery, staged rollouts and rollback, and other features and services for CodePush.

components.name: 👥 Account Management
components.description: Any outages related sign-in, sign-up, permissions, payments, billing and other features or services for managing teams and users.

components.name: 🥫 Cache
components.description: Any outages related to remote build caching, Bazel, Gradle, and Xcode build tools on Bitrise.

components.name: 🤝 3rd Party Integrations
components.description: Integrations that are not managed by Bitrise, but any outages might impact Bitrise features and services.

incident_updates.body: Builds (CI), BuildHub, Release Management and CodePush, Build Cache functionality is gradually getting restored. Remote Dev Environment, and Insight is still under progress. The investigation is ongoing. Customers with identified impact are contacted directly. You can sign in to your account and start reconnecting disconnected services. As a precaution we suggest to rotate secrets, certificates, and tokens. Our teams enabled a Protected Secret Masked Review feature that will help users to safely identify secrets to be rotated. It is available via the show/reveal (eye) icon under Workflow Editor → Secrets and under Workspace settings → Shared resources. Known issues: * ❌ [VM Monitoring] Charts on Bitrise CI build details * ❌ [Project Scanning] Auto configuring new apps * ❌ [Remote Access] Rebuild with remote access What we recommend As a precaution, once you are able to sign in, we recommend that you rotate all secrets, access tokens, and certificates stored in Bitrise. Scope: All Users Severity: SEV-1 When will the next update be available? You can expect a status update approximately 1 hour from now.

incident_updates.body: We have brought api.bitrise.io and app.bitrise.io back online with limited functionality. Expect most features to still be unavailable, but we are actively working on bringing back essential services. Most of our build infrastructure capacity is ready, and we are currently running E2E tests to verify our results before we can restore Builds (CI) functionality. Our teams enabled a Protected Secret Masked Review feature that will help users to safely identify secrets to be rotated. As a precaution, you can sign in to review your workspace settings, connected Git accounts, secrets, certificates, and tokens, and rotate or revoke anything connected to Bitrise. We are making progress restoring the services; full functionality is not expected to be restored before Nov 15th. The services that are brought back are secure. What we recommend As a precaution, once you are able to sign in, we recommend that you rotate all secrets, access tokens, and certificates stored in Bitrise. Services: All Services Scope: All Users Severity: SEV-1 When will the next update be available? You can expect a status update approximately 1 hour from now.

incident_updates.body: What happened? On November 13, 2026 at 11:32 EST (16:32 UTC), we detected suspicious activity in one of our internal cloud environments. Our initial investigation confirmed unauthorized access to an internal system. This system does not store or process customer data. Following our incident response procedures, we immediately took all of our services offline as a precaution while we investigated. At this stage, we have found no evidence that customer data, secrets, or source code were exposed. We are working all hands on the deck to determine the full scope and to restore our services as soon as possible. What we recommend As a precaution, once our services are restored, we recommend that you rotate all secrets, access tokens, and certificates stored in Bitrise. What’s next Our teams are working on completing the investigation and to restore all services safely. We understand the impact this has on your work and appreciate your patience. Services: All Services Scope: All Users Severity: SEV-1 When will the next update be available? You can expect a status update approximately 1 hour from now.
